title: An answered waiting-page item never looks unanswered
why: Your gripe, Oct 27 15:22 CDT (cmsg_01DoF7thf3iq2Srr1UsfXgh2NaqCKqqjiuvUrt4vSAsNt1, with a screenshot): in a local orchestrator's page, items 15, 17 and 19 stayed open for hours after their answers were filed, and item 16 was never filed because its answer waited on its own lane.
note: Today an item stays open until its owning session files the answer in its record and closes it by hand; nothing closes it, and the page shows a saved answer the same as no answer. Fix: the page shows "Answered, filing pending" with the time of your save as soon as you save; the writer closes the item in the same turn it files the answer (skill waiting-page), and an answer whose lane is busy is filed at once as a note on its step, never held for the lane. Overlaps checked: c131 (answers save to their item), c126 (one writer per page) and c136 (one page, ranked) do not cover closing. Red first on an item with a saved answer that still shows as waiting. Needs no answer. Port: yes, the skill installs everywhere. Placed ahead of c135 (triage, Oct 27): a gripe, and a stale open item hides what is really waiting. Green and reviewed: draft PR #744 (dcd78a1b), red first; Opus then Sonnet design review pass at 390 and 1280, light and dark; Sonnet code review round 2 clear (a stale receipt showing filed on a changed answer, fixed). Waits for a batch; c147 follows it.
